_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante : Adjusted EBITDA total (vue d'ensemble), puis EBITDA par segment (NGL plus gros, NGGP, Refined Products & Crude post-Magellan, Natural Gas Pipelines).

kpis.signal: Cle de voute valuation midstream, +29% en 2024 grace Magellan + EnLink, ~90% fee-based
kpis.description_fr: Adjusted EBITDA consolide ONEOK. Croissance dopee par acquisition Magellan (Refined Products & Crude segment cree fin 2023) puis EnLink Controlling Interest (oct 2024).
kpis.description_en: ONEOK consolidated Adjusted EBITDA. Growth driven by Magellan acquisition (Refined Products & Crude segment created late 2023) then EnLink Controlling Interest (Oct 2024).

kpis.name_en: Natural Gas Liquids Segment Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.signal: Segment historique le plus rentable, FY23 dope par gain assurance Medford 779M$
kpis.description_fr: Segment NGL (Natural Gas Liquids) : pipelines, fractionnement, storage Mont Belvieu. Decroissance 2024 vs base FY2023 gonflee par insurance settlement Medford.
kpis.description_en: NGL segment: pipelines, fractionation, Mont Belvieu storage. 2024 decrease vs FY2023 base inflated by Medford insurance settlement.

kpis.name_en: Refined Products and Crude Segment Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.signal: Nouveau segment cree par Magellan Acquisition sept 2023, full-year 2024 = +1.43Md$ vs 3M 2023
kpis.description_fr: Segment cree avec acquisition Magellan Midstream (sept 2023). 2023 = 3 mois partiels (Q4), 2024 = premiere annee complete. Pipelines refined products + crude oil.
kpis.description_en: Segment created via Magellan Midstream acquisition (Sept 2023). 2023 = partial 3 months (Q4), 2024 = first full year. Refined products + crude oil pipelines.

kpis.name_en: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing Segment Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.signal: Croissance reguliere portee par production Rocky Mountain region + EnLink
kpis.description_fr: Segment NGGP : collecte et traitement gaz naturel. 2024 boost EnLink (oct-dec) + volumes Rocky Mountain (Williston Basin).
kpis.description_en: NGGP segment: natural gas gathering and processing. 2024 boost from EnLink (Oct-Dec) + Rocky Mountain volumes (Williston Basin).

kpis.name_en: Natural Gas Pipelines Segment Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.signal: Boost +227M$ en 2024 lie a la cession de 3 interstate pipelines a DT Midstream
kpis.description_fr: Segment Natural Gas Pipelines (transmission interstate, stockage). 2024 inclut gain de cession 227M$ (3 interstate pipelines vendus a DT Midstream).
kpis.description_en: Natural Gas Pipelines segment (interstate transmission, storage). 2024 includes 227M$ divestiture gain (3 interstate pipelines sold to DT Midstream).

kpis_story: ONEOK = midstream americain pure-play fee-based (~90%). Quatre segments : NGL (cle de voute Mont Belvieu), Natural Gas Gathering & Processing (Williston/Permian), Natural Gas Pipelines (interstate), et Refined Products & Crude (cree via Magellan sept 2023). Croissance EBITDA total 2.58Md$ -> 6.78Md$ en 5 ans, dopee par deux M&A majeures (Magellan 2023, EnLink controlling oct 2024).
_notes: Series FY2020-2024. FY2023 segment NGL inclut gain Medford insurance 779M$ (non-recurrent). EnLink Controlling Interest acquisition oct 2024 explique partiellement le saut FY24.
